caveats: Full-page PNGs repeat page content. Normalized row autocorrelation: baseline home-390-top 0.955 at lag 47.7% of image height; r1 home-390-top 1.008 at 67.5%; r1 home-1440-scrolled 1.476 at 72.1%; baseline home-1440-scrolled 0.227 (no repeat). Per-section band stats taken from full-page PNGs below the repeat point are unreliable in BOTH rounds.

section-diff measures the document at 11215 px (1440) while the full-page PNG is 11370 px tall, so band offsets drift up to 155 px. That is why crops/1440-_contact-scrolled.png shows the Cool Things heading and #contact reads ink 0.045.

The globe canvas does not repaint inside a full-page screenshot (rAF only runs while visible): probe-extras shows canvas1 fullPage std 0 vs inViewport std 124.18. Judge it only from viewport captures.
Dark-theme captures force document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme','dark'), which bypasses the app's theme store; the theme toggle icon therefore still shows a moon and is not a finding.

The keyboard audit stops after 80 Tab presses (script cap) and never looped back to body; there are 98 interactive elements at 1440, so the tail of the tab order (footer, fixed buttons) was not traversed. Baseline looped at 72.

The hidden-tab probe overrides document.hidden with a getter; Chromium's own background throttling is not applied, so it measures only whether the app pauses itself. The intervalsAlive counter goes negative (clearInterval calls for ids created before instrumentation) and should be ignored; use intervalFires.
Transfer numbers are cumulative over initial load + one full slow scroll + the three Experience steps + a second slow scroll, not initial load only.
Lighthouse on the dev server uses unminified ungzipped ES modules and 'simulate' throttling; only the preview numbers are comparable to production.
